entries.name: Lower Pit Seam
entries.desc: A thin blue seam in the quarry floor. The Ironpine Gate have fenced it with spears.

entries.name: Grey Pools Seep
entries.desc: Spirit stone grows like salt crust where the grey water seeps out of the bank.

entries.name: Rapids Terrace Vein
entries.desc: The rapids wore the rock back to a vein as thick as an arm.

entries.name: Lightning Scar Lode
entries.desc: Where the lightning strikes most, the ground itself turned to spirit stone.

entries.name: Glass Dunes Lode
entries.desc: A lode under the fused glass. The Scarlet Kiln Sect dig it at night, when the sand is cool.

sects.name: Ironpine Gate
sects.desc: A mountain sect of spearmen who plant their banners like trees and say they never give ground.

sects.name: Blackreed Hall
sects.desc: Marsh-folk in dark veils who sell what they dig to whoever asks fewest questions.

sects.name: Scarlet Kiln Sect
sects.desc: Forge-cultivators of the Expanse. They burn spirit stones by the cartload to keep their kilns hot.
